mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_dd_case_dependency(dependency_id, parent_case_id, child_case_id, dependency_type, required_flag, version, create_time, update_time) VALUES(#{row.dependencyId}, #{row.parentCaseId}, #{row.childCaseId}, #{row.dependencyType}, #{row.requiredFlag}, #{row.version}, #{row.createTime}, #{row.updateTime})
mapper.select: SELECT dependency_id AS dependencyId, parent_case_id AS parentCaseId, child_case_id AS childCaseId, dependency_type AS dependencyType, required_flag AS requiredFlag, version, create_time AS createTime, update_time AS updateTime FROM t_dd_case_dependency WHERE parent_case_id = #{parentCaseId} ORDER BY dependency_id
